title: feat(lint): a record trigger that names no object opens its flow to the CEL root judge; the runtime gate stand-down is by design
body:
Fixes #22636
Clause-②: yes (widening: a flow whose `record-*` trigger names no start `config.objectName` opens, so `validate` no longer reports an unbound flow CEL root there)

Executes ruling `6104584601` (letter B) on #22636: ruling `5791822697` item 3 stands, so the runtime publish gate keeps its per-write snapshot and its stand-down on the flow CEL unbound-root judgment is by design. W (the snapshot carrying flows and actions) is not built. This PR carries the three items the ruling names, all in `packages/lint`, plus (patch round 1, seat order `6105130863`) the correction of two pending release notes that still called the stand-down temporary.

## What changes

1. **S is reworded from a hold-out to the ruled boundary.** The stand-down itself (`perWriteSnapshotEntrance`) is unchanged in code. Its wording changes from "until #22636 widens the snapshot" to "by design": who launches a flow and what record it is handed are read from other items of the stack, so this is a whole-stack judgment and belongs to `objectstack validate` (ADR-0109 Decision §3's boundary). The text cites ruling `5791822697` (item 3) and ruling `6104584601`. It changes in:
   - `flow-cel-root-scope.ts`: the module header section (now "The runtime publish gate stands down, by design") and `perWriteSnapshotEntrance`'s docblock;
   - `validate-expressions.ts`: the comment above `runtimeGateWrite` (comment only);
   - `validate-expressions.flow-cel-root.test.ts`: the S block's docblock and describe title (now `the runtime publish gate stands down by design (S)`), and the `record` block's docblock. The S pins themselves are unchanged: the gate stands down, and the build door refuses the same root on the same flow.
2. **A `record-*` trigger with no start `config.objectName` opens the flow.** `flowCelEntrances` gains one open reason. It applies when the trigger kind is `record_change` (`resolveFlowTriggerKind`: start `config.triggerType` is a `record-*` string) and the start node names no `config.objectName`. Measured on the runtime: `deriveTriggerBinding` (`engine.ts`) binds `object: undefined`, and `record-change-trigger.ts` registers the hook with `object: binding.object`, so the hook has no object filter. It fires on a write to any object, including one the stack does not declare, and hands that row (`binding.object ?? ctx.object`). The build door cannot know the record's keys, so it leaves the flow unjudged, as it already does for a record trigger on an undeclared object. ⛔ The trigger shape is not refused (no new gate, no narrowing). The module header's entrance list gains the bullet.
3. **The owed `map`-child pin** (carry note `6096005997`, from contract review `6095756455` ③). A `map` child of an open parent is opened by the fixpoint. The pin has three parts: one level, two levels (g → map → h → map → f), and a red control (the same `map` node in a parent no entrance opens leaves the child judged). Each `map` node's `itemObject` names a declared object, so the node cannot open the child by itself; only the parent's openness can. No behaviour change: the pin was green before the fix commit (below), and `map-node.ts` spreads the parent context and overrides `record` only for an id-bearing item.
4. **Two pending release notes say "by design" (patch round 1, `2c06d027e8`).** Under ruling B, two `@objectstack/lint` changesets that have not been released yet were stating something false. In each, only the "yet" / "until …" clause changes; the rest of the sentence, the front matter, the levels and the `Clause-②` lines are byte-identical.
   - `.changeset/22565-flow-cel-unbound-root-refused.md:34`: "a flow write there is not judged for unbound roots ~~yet~~, by design (rulings `5791822697` item 3 and `6104584601`)."
   - `.changeset/22677-flow-cel-record-entrance.md:20`: "…and a flow write there is not refused for `record` ~~until that snapshot carries them~~, by design (rulings `5791822697` item 3 and `6104584601`)."

`.changeset/22636-flow-cel-record-trigger-no-object-opens.md`: `@objectstack/lint` `minor`, carrying the `Clause-②` line above. `check-changeset-no-major`'s level axis requires at least `minor` for a `yes (widening)` declaration.

## Measured before writing

- **Today's behaviour for the objectName-less record trigger: closed and judged.** `flowCelEntrances` hands the flow `record` and opens nothing. Its root is judged against every declared object's fields, so `user.id` is refused there. The new pin was committed first (`49c47a4e51`) and run on the unfixed source: `Tests  1 failed | 78 passed (79)`, the failure being `a record trigger that names no start config.objectName stands down…` with `AssertionError: expected [ { …(4) } ] to deeply equal []`. The `map`-child pin was green in the same run.
- **The corpus has no such trigger.** Loaded configs (`tsx` import of each `objectstack.config.ts`), at `e7e6544ab9`: `app-crm` 1 flow and 0 record triggers; `app-multi-package` 0 flows; `app-showcase` 30 flows, 19 record triggers, 19 naming `objectName`; `app-todo` 4 flows, 1 record trigger, 1 naming it.
- `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` (`rule-explanations.ts`) carries no S wording: no "until", "snapshot" or stand-down sentence for the flow CEL root judgment. Not touched.

## Tests (at `bd22088e0b`; the later commits `337de825af` and `2c06d027e8` edit only changeset text)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (the whole package): `Test Files  136 passed (136)`, `Tests  6353 passed (6353)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`, whose `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*`, so it compiles the test file): exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK … 2 file(s) / 6 error(s) / 2 pinned signature(s) held` (pre-existing, unchanged; the edited test file is not in the ledger, so it compiles with zero errors).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build`: exit 0, `check-dts-emitted: @objectstack/lint - 6/6 declared declaration file(s) present`.

**Ablation of the new open reason.** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/lint/src/flow-cel-root-scope.ts --anchor "if (kind === 'record_change' && !triggerObject) {" --replacement "if (false && kind === 'record_change' && !triggerObject) {" -- pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-expressions.flow-cel-root.test.ts`
- The mutation landed on disk: `anchor x1 -> x0`, `replace x0 -> x1`, blob `274a60f90d10 -> 392c0b3b88f6`.
- Run with the mutation in place: `Tests  1 failed | 78 passed (79)`, the one red being the new record-trigger pin.
- Restored and proven: `blob == HEAD (274a60f90d10) and git diff HEAD is empty`, and `git status --porcelain` was empty afterwards.
- The test imports the module by relative path (`./flow-cel-root-scope.js`), so the run reads `src/`, not `dist/`. No rebuild leg was needed.

## `objectstack validate` on the four example apps, before and after

`node packages/cli/bin/run.js validate --json` in each example directory. Before: lint `dist/index.js` built at `49c47a4e51`, the unfixed source, sha256 `5a2bfdb33967b164…`. After: rebuilt at `bd22088e0b`, sha256 `3a0412ddb92568a7…`. Every app exits 0 with `valid: true` both times, and the error and warning lists are byte-identical before and after (`diff` of the sorted finding arrays: 0 lines).

| app | errors | warnings by id (before = after) |
|---|---|---|
| `app-crm` | 0 | `field-no-consumers` 9 |
| `app-multi-package` | 0 | `field-no-consumers` 3 |
| `app-showcase` | 0 | `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty` 11, `field-no-consumers` 51, `flow-draft-status-ambiguous` 1, `flow-loop-body-uncontained` 2, `liveness-planned-property` 2, `sdui/jsx-parse-level-only` 1, `security-private-no-readscope` 2, `title-unresolvable` 1 |
| `app-todo` | 0 | `field-no-consumers` 5, `flow-draft-status-ambiguous` 2 |

The widening removes nothing here because no shipped record trigger lacks `objectName` (above). It adds nothing anywhere: the change only sets an `openedBy`, and an open flow is judged for no root.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at the final head `337de825af`: 62 commands (30 pnpm, 32 direct node), the same list as at `bd22088e0b`. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe. The diff-reading ones (the changeset, citation, docs-audit, doc-authoring and nul-byte gates) were re-run at `337de825af` after the last commit. Reconciled with `--ran`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (0 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3, 1 claimed)`.

- **61 run, all exit 0.** Among them:
  - `check-adr-0087-registration`: `this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset (1 non-breaking changeset(s) seen)`;
  - `check-changeset-no-major`: `This diff introduces no major bump`; its level axis, driven offline with `--event` over this body, reads `LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② yes (widening), and no package whose packages/**/src/** it moves is graded patch` and exits 0;
  - `check-empty-changeset`: `No changeset from the merge base modified or deleted by this diff`;
  - `check-issue-citations`: `every citation this change adds resolves`;
  - `check:nul-bytes`: `scanned 10782 text file(s) … no raw ASCII control bytes`;
  - `check:dts-closure`: `161/161 declared declaration file(s) present across 62 package(s)`;
  - `check:test-source-alias` and `check:cross-package-test-inputs`: OK.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3: six unrelated packages had no `dist/`). Those six were built under the verify lock, and it then exited 0.
- **NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:type-check-debt`.** The script is `check-type-check-coverage.mjs --re-measure`, which the dispatch forbids running locally; CI runs it. `pnpm check:type-check-coverage` (no re-measure) ran: exit 0.
- Also run, outside this derivation: the three roster gates that keep their roster under `packages/` (`check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`), all exit 0.
- **NOT MEASURED, CI's own shell** (no local invocation): the five path-scheduled CI jobs (Test Core, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Regression Gate, Dogfood Verify CLI, Build Core) and the workspace type-check lanes. The lint package's own `typecheck` ran (above).

**Patch round 1, at `2c06d027e8`.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the two changeset paths derived 20 commands. 19 exited 0, among them:
- `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: `this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset (3 non-breaking changeset(s) seen)`;
- `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`: `This diff introduces no major bump`;
- `check:nul-bytes`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:published-files` and `check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`.

**One is red by design:** `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` exits 1 on the foreign-changeset rule, naming both files. This is its DELIBERATE CORRECTION class, so the confirmation request is below. `Check Changeset` (not a required context) is `success` at `337de825af` and `failure` at `2c06d027e8`. Its two failure annotations are those two files.

## Acceptance notes

- **Confirmation requested — DELIBERATE CORRECTION of two pending release notes (`check-empty-changeset`'s foreign-changeset rule).** This PR changes `.changeset/22565-flow-cel-unbound-root-refused.md` (from PR #22609) and `.changeset/22677-flow-cel-record-entrance.md` (from PR #22730). Both are notes this PR did not add. What changed under them: ruling `6104584601` made the runtime gate's stand-down permanent, so "not judged … yet" and "not refused … until that snapshot carries them" became false. Each now says "by design", and nothing else in either file moved. Neither note has been consumed into `packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md`. Ordered by the `domain:spec` seat in `6105130863`; ⛔ do not restore either file from the base, which would republish the false sentence. Per the workflow's route for this class, `skip-changeset` is not applied and the red is left standing for the approver to merge over.
- `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` carries no S wording, so nothing is routed behind the `domain:spec` seat's #22161 slice 8.
- The ruling names one contract-review-tier review for this PR (its `Clause-②` is `yes (widening)`).
- The advisory Docs Drift Check listed 13 pages through the `record_change` string literal. None of them describes the build door's unbound-root judgment: `git grep -n -i -E "unbound root|Unknown variable: (user|record)|is not bound in|flowCelEntrances|objectName.{0,40}(omit|without|no )"` over the 13 exits 1.
- `runtime-gate.ts` and `authoring-rules.ts` cite ruling `5791822697` and contain no "until #22636". They are untouched.
- A `triggerType` array (`['record-after-create', …]`) resolves to no kind in `resolveFlowTriggerKind`, so it does not reach the new open reason. The engine routes that shape only so it can refuse it at bind, and lint already reports it as `flow-trigger-unknown-event`. Unchanged, by that resolver's documented decision.
